name: Iwatsuka Confectionery Co., Ltd.
summary: Iwatsuka Confectionery Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells rice crackers in Japan. The company offers black bean and rice crackers under Iwatsuka brand name; country rice crackers; taste savory; THE pinch; Osodefuri bean mochi; fluffy; kinako mochi; banzai sansho pepper; and Niigata wet rice crackers.It also provides sweets made from rice and boxed rice crackers/gifts. The company was formerly known as Iwatsuka Nosan Kakojo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Iwatsuka Confectionery Co., Ltd. in 1960. Iwatsuka Confectionery Co., Ltd. was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Nagaoka, Japan.
